description:
Wikilayer is a wiki ChatGPT can read and edit. Ask it to draft a page, reorganise a section, or pull a fact from existing content, and the changes appear at a wikilayer.org URL with a normal wiki interface — pages, headings, blocks, and a table of contents.

ChatGPT navigates the wiki by outline and fetches only the blocks it needs, so it can keep working with the wiki as it grows past what fits in one conversation.

interface.longDescription:
Wikilayer is a wiki ChatGPT can read and edit. Ask it to draft a page, reorganise a section, or pull a fact from existing content, and the changes appear at a wikilayer.org URL with a normal wiki interface — pages, headings, blocks, and a table of contents.

ChatGPT navigates the wiki by outline and fetches only the blocks it needs, so it can keep working with the wiki as it grows past what fits in one conversation.

Wikilayer reads and writes only the wikis your connected account can reach. A new wiki is private; a public one is readable by anyone on the web, so ChatGPT asks before making a wiki public, sharing a page by link or deleting pages.
defaultPrompt: Make me a wiki covering all the main London airports.

positive.prompt: Make me a private wiki covering the main London airports, one page per airport.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a private wiki with a page for each main London airport and returns links to the wiki and its pages.

positive.prompt: In my London airports wiki, which airport is furthest from central London?
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the airport pages and answers from what they say, linking the page it relied on.

positive.description: Add a section to a page
positive.prompt: Add a section about getting there by train to the Heathrow page.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a new section block to the Heathrow page without changing its other sections and returns the page link.

positive.prompt: Put Luton and Stansted under a new page called Outside London.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the Outside London page and moves the Luton and Stansted pages under it, keeping their content.

positive.prompt: Which pages in my airports wiki mention the Elizabeth line?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the pages and sections that mention the Elizabeth line, with links, or says that none do.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight from Heathrow to Paris tomorrow.
Edit the Wikipedia article about Heathrow Airport.
Show me the private wikis of another Wikilayer user.

review.commerce_description: Wikilayer does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Tool hints now say what each tool can do: tools that write to a wiki or read wikis other people publish are marked as reaching the open web, and tools that overwrite or delete content are marked destructive. Adds a get-started skill.
